origins.section: An Infeasible Year Returns a Feasibility Cut From a Shortfall LP
The Master Is an Upper Bound, Each Plan's True Value a Lower Bound; Stop When They Meet
HiGHS Cannot Take the Cuts Inside Its Search; SCIP Can, as Lazy Constraints

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-feasibility: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-feasibility: "The course uses a route that needs no ray and works with any LP solver: the shortfall LP ... When it is positive, its duals σ make the same argument ... so a plan with that sum above zero cannot be covered. The feasibility cut is ..." The page adds that the master needs a row that forbids this plan "and every plan that fails for the same reason".
recorded.prompt:q-early-stop: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-early-stop: "The master's optimum is an upper bound on the whole model". A feasible plan's true value is "a lower bound". Also "a loop stopped early still gives an honest gap between its two bounds." So the optimum lies in [51,200, 51,800], and the 51,200 plan is the feasible one in hand.
recorded.prompt:q-lazy: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-lazy: HiGHS never called the callback, so it solved the master with no cuts, the master that believes crews are free, as in iteration 1 of the loop.

recorded.prompt:q-feasibility:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-feasibility:a: "Q_2031(x̂) = +∞, and no optimality cut can say so. The master needs ... a feasibility cut."
recorded.prompt:q-feasibility:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-feasibility:b: The page's output shows GLOP gives no ray: "GLOP  INFEASIBLE dual ray: False". It also says "MathOpt's GLOP and HiGHS do not return one here".
recorded.prompt:q-feasibility:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-feasibility:d: "The master needs a row that forbids this plan, and every plan that fails for the same reason."
recorded.prompt:q-early-stop:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-early-stop:a: The master's value is only an upper bound. It equals the optimum only "When the master's θ_y already equal the Q_y(x̂) ... the two bounds meet". A loop stopped early gives "an honest gap between its two bounds", not the optimum.
recorded.prompt:q-early-stop:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-early-stop:b: "The master's optimum is an upper bound on the whole model ... adding cuts can only lower it."
recorded.prompt:q-early-stop:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-early-stop:c: A feasible plan's true value is "a feasible plan's value, a lower bound", so the optimum cannot lie below 51,200.
recorded.prompt:q-lazy:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-lazy:a: Lesson 4.3.5 showed that HiGHS through MathOpt accepts a lazy-constraint callback, never calls it, and returns plans that break the lazy rows.
recorded.prompt:q-lazy:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-lazy:c: The cuts are not weaker in one search: sent by the same function to SCIP, they reach 23,812.25 above.
recorded.prompt:q-lazy:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-lazy:d: The loop did not stop early: its two bounds met at 23,812.25, the monolithic MILP's value.
